task: imagined left fist (T1) versus imagined right fist (T2)
source_rate_hz: per-file EDF header: 160 or 128; use each file's actual rate
filter: same 250 Hz causal notch 50 Hz then 1-45 Hz as Cyton ARM, after resample
features: log Welch bandpower in 8-12 and 18-26 Hz, in channel order above
model_selection: pick by mean per-subject balanced accuracy on subjects 71-89; refit on 1-89; evaluate 90-109 once
promotion_gate: mean test balanced accuracy >=0.60 and subject-bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.50
deployment_status: offline candidate only until gate and numerical portability pass; never a control command
